Container.Name: beeper-bridge
Container.Overview: Run one official self-hosted Beeper bridge in this container. Every bridge reuses the same appdata folder. To add another bridge, install this template again with a new container name and a new bridge name. Two containers may share the folder only when their bridge names differ. Self-hosting is outside normal Beeper support. Docs: https://developers.beeper.com/bridges/self-hosting/ Help: #self-hosting:beeper.com

Config.Name: Bridge Name
Config.Description: Bridge to run. Use sh- plus a bridge id, for example sh-whatsapp or sh-telegram. The README lists every supported id. Each container needs its own bridge name. iMessage and iMessage Go are not supported by this template.

Config.Name: Beeper Access Token
Config.Description: Beeper access token. Copy it from Beeper Desktop under Settings, Help and About, or from the access_token field in ~/.config/bbctl/config.json after bbctl login on another machine. A change here applies the next time this container starts.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Shared data folder for every bridge container. Keep this path the same for every bridge. Two containers may use this same folder only when their bridge names differ.
